rule: pre-registration section 4, Branch B (decision D-R18); part 1 is labeling_kappa.compare

adjudication_csv.note: author_decision and author_reasoning are for the author; this tool never edits a label

kappa.rule: pre-registration section 4, Branch B (decision D-R18; decision D-R19; decision D-R20)

gate.name: Self-verified
gate.name_reason: the point estimate is at least 0.70

adjudicated_case_count.definition: cases whose two passes differ on any compared label (eligibility on each item, variance direction, band, evidence state, or an amount): both passes give it and the values differ (amounts more than $1 apart), or one pass gives it and the other leaves it blank, unreadable or absent (pre-registration section 8; decision D-R20)

timing.rule: on each case the second pass's start on that case is at least 48 hours after the first pass's export time, or after the first pass's last recorded time on that case when that is later (pre-registration section 4; decision D-R20)
